scope: Separate, uniformly scaled nine-second X/Y/Z inputs at the audited stress-free M4 assembly. The first monitored change is the earliest in amplitude among originally loaded middle-pocket points and four spacer seats, over all sampled times. Additional contacts can change the response sooner. RMS refers to the stationary portion of the original periodic input. These thresholds test the assumed contact state and give no material strength or fatigue limit.
